title: Page 1
slug: 捡夫宝娘子-金妍-戚家四兄弟只剩他戚无双这个当家老大还未娶妻-看弟弟们恩爱成双加上每天被媒婆们当大肥羊紧盯著-他烦不胜烦
content_zh:
戚家，京城内数一数二的富商，从事茶楼、镳局、布庄、钱庄四种买卖，各由戚家四位公子掌管打理，可以说是无人不知、无人不晓，在商界内的势力可是大得吓人。
戚家近来连连传出喜事，老四、老三、老二相继和所爱的女人成亲，戚家上下都笼罩在欢乐的气氛当中，也因为多了三位少夫人的关系，让戚家顿时热闹了不少。
但在一片热闹的气氛当中，还是有一个人一点都开心不起来，那个人就是大公子——戚无双。
书房里，戚无双正坐在椅子上，他身穿暗紫色上好绸缎所制成的衣裳，衣缘滚着金色云纹绣线，做工精致，腰挂上好翠玉坠饰，显得高贵不凡，那总是带笑的眉眼乍看之下颇有亲和力，但只有真正认识他的人才知道，他脸上笑归笑，但心底到底在想些什么，没人捉摸得到。
只不过此刻的他完全笑不出来，死瞪着围在他前面的五位媒婆，来找上他的媒婆少说也有十几位，但只有这五位在经历了一连串的介绍失败之后，还是不死心地缠着他，让他烦不胜烦。
这群三姑六婆到底是怎么一回事，难道整座京城的男人全都娶了老婆，就只剩他一个人还是独身，所以她们都没生意做，只能死抓着他不放？
“戚大公子，我这次要帮您说媒的对象，您绝对会有兴趣的！”
“戚大公子，您年纪也不小了，是该成家的时候，别再蹉跎下去……”
“您的其它弟弟都已经成婚，您也该为自己着想，是该找个伴的时候了。”
这五位媒婆，默契还真是好，不约而同都选在今天登门拜访，而一看到还有其它媒婆在，每一位更是卯足劲努力想争取他的注意。
五个女人五张嘴，但她们一起开口说话，嘈杂得像似有十张嘴在对着他讲话，叽叽喳喳、叽叽喳喳，讲完一轮又一轮，像是永远都不会口渴似的。
他只是不想娶妻而已，有碍到什么人吗？有谁规定人一定得结婚生子？他自己都不急了，这些媒婆到底是在替他急些什么？
不只这些媒婆，他在商场上有所往来的合伙人、客人、甚至是有交情的官员，都想帮他说媒，非得要他成亲不可。
为什么他得忍受这些事情？他已经快要受不了了！
“戚大公子，您一定要看看她……”
“那位姑娘真的是绝世美女，您绝对会喜欢的。”
“我帮您找的对象绝对旺夫又旺子，一定……”
“够了，妳们全都住嘴！”他猛力一拍桌子，终于火大地抓狂了。
“嗄？”没见过他失控，媒婆们全都吓了一大跳。
戚无双霍地从椅子上站起身，离开书房，懒得再应付这些媒婆，只想甩开这些烦人的事情。

“等等，戚大公子，别走呀……”众家媒婆赶紧追上，硬是不肯放弃。
戚无双在穿廊上疾走，媒婆们也不死心地在后头追赶，这景况看来非常可笑，媒婆们一边追赶，嘴巴也没有停下来，继续叽叽喳喳，吵得他的头都痛了。
他受不了一天到晚都因为婚事被人给缠着，为了图个清静，他决定暂时离开京城，去哪里都好，就是不要再留在这里让各方人马“觊觎”他这块肥肉！
他穿过回廊，经过花园，往大门的方向前进，这时二公子戚无烟恰巧也路过花园，看到大哥背后那一群紧追不放的媒婆，大概也猜得出来发生了什么事。
“大哥，你要去哪儿？”大哥平常总是笑脸迎人，这会儿却板起臭脸，看来大哥终于被那些媒婆给烦到抓狂了。
“二弟，你来得正好，我不在的这段期间，戚家就由你来当家。”他脚步停都没停。
“我当家？那你呢？”
“我打算出京去巡视各钱庄分号的营运情况，短期内不会回来。”他所掌管的无戚钱庄，不只在京城有，外头的各个县城也有分号，正好趁这个机会到处走走。
大哥摆明了就是要离京“避难”去吧？“大哥，你的‘短期’到底是多久？总得让我有个底吧。”
“说实话，我自己也没个底，你好自为之吧……”戚无双勾起一抹贼笑，存心把当家的麻烦事全都赖给二弟，一身轻松地逍遥去。
或许一、两个月，或许更久，这些年来在商场上打滚，他已经感到有些疲累，是时候该放自己清闲一下了。
等他在外头绕一圈回来，这些人应该也差不多对他放弃了吧？反正他是不打算娶妻的，谁能奈他何？
“嗄？大哥，别走——”戚无烟脸色一变，要他暂时帮忙几天，他是没话说，但如果一帮下去没完没了，始终不见大哥回来，不就换他被困死在当家这个位置上了？
“哈哈哈……”戚无双朗笑出声，恣意又狂放，不管死缠不休的媒婆、不管苦恼哀号的二弟，反正他想做的事情，没人可以阻挡。
但他没想到的是，这一趟临时兴起的出行，却出了意外，把他所有的计划全都打乱了……
第1章(1)
一个月后，宣河县城外的树林里——
一大清早，宝安儿就提着一个竹篮和贵叔来到树林里，摘取做肉包子所要用的独门提味香料，在这之前，暴风雨来袭，整整一天风强雨大，她真担心野生的香料会被暴风雨给打坏。
幸好野生的香料虽然被打坏不少，还是有幸存可用的，她将剩余的香料摘下来，心想应该还够她用上个十天，暂时不必担心。
她边采边走，深入林子里，来到因为暴风雨而变得黄浊的河水旁，不经意一瞥，猛地倒抽一口气，双眼睁得老大。

“咦咦咦？这是什么？”
就在河岸旁，一名身穿紫衣的男子恰巧被卡在横倒在河边的枯树枝上，上半身趴在枯枝上，下半身泡在水里，随着河水载浮载沈，脸色苍白，不知生死，应该是从河的上游给冲下来的。
他到底死了没？宝安儿的脸色也跟着刷白，心跳得飞快，紧张不已，毕竟她从没遇过这种事情。
她慢慢来到岸边，小心地观察那男子，发现他紧皱着双眉，胸口微微起伏着，看来还没死，但没死对她来说……才是真正的棘手呀！
如果死了，她顶多把他埋在附近，算是仁至义尽；没死的话，可就不是这么简单就能解决的事。
但见死不救，她会良心不安；而救了他，她又担负不起……
“不行不行，先让我想想……”她开始扳起手指，精打细算起来。“如果救他，一定得请大夫来帮他看病，家里又会多一口吃饭的人，吃饭这种事还不打紧，如果他伤得重的话，买药钱就会是一笔不小的数目，要是还得帮他买补品补身子，我哪来的银两啊……”
“嗯，什么声音？”她抬起头，怎么好像听到有东西断裂的声音？
“咦，好像在前方？”她定睛一看，顿时惊愕地瞪大双眼，终于发现是怎么一回事了。
是树枝！卡住男人的树枝似乎不堪他的重量，在靠近根部的地方出现一道裂痕，并且越来越大了。
怎么办？不救的话，他就快随着断裂的树枝被河水给冲走了。
“啊啊啊——不行——”看着树枝的断裂处在一瞬间断个彻底，男人的上半身眼看即将沈入水底，宝安儿丢下竹篮，在最后关头紧抓住男人一臂，已经顾不得其它了。
救就救吧，或许这就是她的命，想躲也躲不了！
content_en:
The Qi family, one of the most wealthy businessmen in the capital, is engaged in four types of businesses: teahouses, bureaus, cloth stores, and banks. Each of them is managed by the four sons of the Qi family. It can be said that everyone knows about it and its influence in the business world is terrifying.
There have been a lot of happy events in the Qi family recently. The fourth, third and second children have got married to the women they love one after another. The whole Qi family is enveloped in an atmosphere of joy, and because of the addition of three young ladies, the Qi family has suddenly become a lot more lively.
But in the bustling atmosphere, there was still one person who was not happy at all. That person was the eldest son--Qi Wushuang.
In the study, Qi Wushuang was sitting on a chair. He was wearing a dress made of dark purple fine silk, with golden moiré embroidery thread rolling around the edges. The workmanship was exquisite, and a fine jade pendant hung around his waist, which made him look noble and extraordinary. His always smiling eyebrows seemed quite friendly at first glance, but only those who really knew him knew that he was always smiling, but no one could figure out what he was thinking in his heart.
It's just that he couldn't laugh at all at this moment, staring at the five matchmakers surrounding him. There were at least a dozen matchmakers who came to see him, but only these five still persisted in pestering him after a series of failed introductions, making him extremely annoyed.
What is going on with these three aunts and six women? Is it possible that all the men in the capital have married wives, and he is the only one who is still single, so they have no business and can only cling to him?
"Master Qi, I am going to help you find a matchmaker this time. You will definitely be interested!"
"Master Qi, you are not young anymore. It's time to start a family. Don't waste any more time..."
"Your other brothers are already married, so you should think about yourself. It's time to find a partner."
These five matchmakers had a really good tacit understanding, and they all chose today to visit. When they saw that there were other matchmakers there, each of them tried their best to win his attention.
There were five women with five mouths, but they all spoke together. It was so noisy that there were ten mouths talking to him, chattering, chattering, talking one after another, as if they would never be thirsty.
He just doesn't want to get a wife, will it bother anyone? Who stipulates that people must get married and have children? He himself is no longer anxious. What are these matchmakers anxious for?
Not only these matchmakers, but also his partners, customers, and even officials with whom he had friendships in the shopping mall all wanted to help him find a matchmaker and had to get him married.
Why does he have to put up with these things? He couldn't stand it anymore!
"Master Qi, you must take a look at her..."
"That girl is really a stunning beauty, you will definitely like her."
"The person I'm looking for for you will definitely be a prosperous husband and son, and he will definitely..."
"That's enough, you all shut up!" He slammed the table, finally going crazy.
"Huh?" They had never seen him lose control, and the matchmakers were all shocked.
Qi Wushuang stood up from the chair and left the study. He was too lazy to deal with these matchmakers and just wanted to get rid of these annoying things.
"Wait, Mr. Qi, don't leave..." The matchmakers quickly caught up and refused to give up.
Qi Wushuang was running fast on the corridor, and the matchmakers were chasing behind him. This situation seemed very ridiculous. The matchmakers did not stop talking while chasing, and they continued to chatter, which made his head hurt.
He couldn't stand being pestered about his marriage all day long. In order to have some peace and quiet, he decided to leave the capital temporarily. He could go anywhere, but he just didn't want to stay here and let everyone "covet" his piece of fat!
He walked through the cloister, passed the garden, and headed towards the gate. At this time, the second young master Qi Wuyan happened to be passing by the garden. He saw the group of matchmakers chasing behind his eldest brother, and he could probably guess what happened.
"Brother, where are you going?Son? "The eldest brother usually always greets people with a smile, but now he has a stern face. It seems that the eldest brother has finally been annoyed by those matchmakers and gone crazy.
"Second brother, you are here at the right time. During my absence, you will be in charge of the Qi family. "He didn't even stop.
"Am I in charge? What about you? "
"I plan to leave Beijing to inspect the operations of various bank branches and will not be back in the short term. "The Wuqi Bank he is in charge of is not only in the capital, but also in various counties outside. He just took this opportunity to travel around.
The eldest brother has made it clear that he wants to leave Beijing to "escape", right? "Brother, how long is your 'short term'? I have to have a bottom line. "
"To be honest, I don't know what I'm doing, so you can do it on your own..." Qi Wushuang gave a sly smile, deliberately blaming all the family's troubles on his second brother, and walked away with ease.
Maybe one or two months, maybe longer. After all these years of wallowing in the mall, he has already felt a little tired, and it's time to relax for a while.
By the time he comes back from going around outside, these people should have almost given up on him, right? Anyway, he doesn't plan to get a wife, so who can do anything to him?
"Huh? Brother, don't leave -" Qi Wuyan's expression changed, and he had nothing to say if he asked him to help temporarily for a few days, but if the gang goes on forever and the elder brother never comes back, won't he be trapped in the position of the leader and die?
"Hahaha..." Qi Wushuang laughed loudly, wantonly and wildly. No matter the matchmaker who was obsessed with him or the second brother who was distressed and wailing, no one could stop him from what he wanted to do anyway.
But what he didn't expect was that this impromptu trip would lead to an accident, disrupting all his plans...
Chapter 1(1)
A month later, in the woods outside Xuanhe County—
Early in the morning, Bao An'er carried a bamboo basket and went to the woods with Uncle Gui to pick the unique spices used to make meat buns. Before that, a storm hit, with strong wind and rain all day long. She was really worried that the wild spices would be damaged by the storm.
Fortunately, although a lot of wild spices were damaged, there were still some that could be used. She picked the remaining spices, thinking that there would be enough for her to use for ten days, so she didn't have to worry about it for the time being.
She walked deep into the forest while picking, and came to the river that had turned yellow due to the storm. She glanced at it casually, took a sharp breath, and opened her eyes wide.
“Eh heh heh? What's this? "
Just next to the river bank, a man in purple clothes happened to be stuck on a dead branch that fell across the river. His upper body was lying on the dead branch, and his lower body was soaked in the water. He was floating and sinking with the river. His face was pale and he didn't know whether he was alive or dead. He must have been washed down from the upper reaches of the river.
Is he dead? Bao An'er's face also turned pale, her heart was beating fast and she was very nervous. After all, she had never encountered such a thing.
She slowly came to the shore and carefully observed the man. She found that his eyebrows were furrowed and his chest was rising and falling slightly. It seemed that he was not dead yet, but not being dead was the real trouble for her...
If he died, the most she could do was bury him nearby, which would be considered as the utmost kindness; if he didn't die, it wouldn't be such a simple matter.
But if she doesn't save him, she will feel uneasy about her conscience; and if she saves him, she can't afford it...
"No, no, let me think about it first..." She began to raise her fingers and calculate carefully. "If we save him, we must ask a doctor to see him. There will be another person in the family to eat. Food is not a big deal. If he is seriously injured, the money to buy medicine will be a lot of money. If I have to buy supplements for him to replenish his health, where will I get the money..."
"Hmm, what's the sound? "She raised her head, why did she seem to hear the sound of something breaking?
"Hey, it seems to be in front? "She took a closer look, and her eyes widened in shock, finally realizing what was going on.
It's a branch! The tree that stuck the manThe branch seemed to be unable to bear his weight, and a crack appeared near the root, and it became bigger and bigger.
what to do? If he didn't save him, he would be washed away by the river along with the broken branches.
"Ahhhh - no way -" Seeing that the branch was completely broken in an instant, and the man's upper body was about to sink into the water, Bao An'er dropped the bamboo basket and grabbed the man's arm tightly at the last moment, no longer caring about anything else.
Just save her, maybe this is her life, she can't hide even if she wants to!
